title: Out and About!

intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi learned the magic words and said a big, brave sorry. 💝
Today is Saturday — Kimi and Mom are going OUT!

scenes.title: Stop, Look, Cross!
scenes.caption:
First, cross the big road.
Red light... green light...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Always cross at crosswalks. Watch for the traffic lights.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Make sure you walk when the light is green! 🟢

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Hold my hand. Don't run — you could trip and fall.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Look sideways while walking. I know, Mom!

scenes.title: The Magic Elevator
scenes.caption:
Kimi's favorite machine in the world:
the elevator! Who gets to push the button?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Let me push the button! ☝️

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: The elevator is here. Let's get on.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: What floor should we press?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: The first floor, please! Going down! 🛗

scenes.title: Stranger Danger
scenes.caption:
At the park, a stranger offers Kimi candy...
What should she do?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't talk to strangers. Don't follow anyone even if they ask.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't tell a stranger your name or number.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Just say no, firmly! NO, thank you! 🙅‍♀️

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: And if something feels wrong, just run and tell Mom. Good girl!

scenes.title: Playground Rules
scenes.caption:
Wheee! The slide, the seesaw,
the whole playground is Kimi's!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, I want to play on the playground!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Okay! Then let's go out together.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I can slide down by myself!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: You should not walk up the slide. Don't climb up too high!

scenes.title: The Great Sandcastle
scenes.caption:
Roll up your sleeves!
Squishy, tickly sand between the toes...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's go and play in the sandbox. Roll up our sleeves first.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: The sand is softly slipping through my fingers! It's tickling my toes! 😆

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's build a sandcastle.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Wow, we made a nice castle! 🏰

scenes.title: Five Jumps & Rainbow Bubbles
scenes.caption:
Yesterday: 3 jumps. Today: can Kimi
beat her record? Then — bubble time!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: One, two, three — oops! The rope got caught on my foot. 😂

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Yesterday you jumped 3 times, and today you did 5 times!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Yay! Now blow bubbles with me, Mom!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Look! The bubble is the rainbow color. Don't drink the soap water! 🫧

songs: 🚦 Cross when the light is green

ending.title: What a Big Day Outside!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: Ouch! Boo-Boo Day! 🩹
